subregion.name: The Chemical Laboratories
subregion.summary: Workbenches, distillers, and sample storage across the northern central core.

subregion.name: The Dissection Halls
subregion.summary: Operating theaters and preparation halls located between the western and southern wings.

subregion.name: The Experimental Chambers
subregion.summary: Isolated testing suites and trial chambers filling the far western wing.

subregion.summary: Security checkpoints and transit passages controlling access in the northwest.

subregion.name: The Subterranean Vats
